title: Final matched T16 temporal extension before any new spatial Reference level
scientific_question: At T16, do the R512 and R1024 temporal shifts continue to converge and does the matched R512-R1024 spatial gap stabilize, reverse, or continue increasing relative to T8?

spatial: R512-R1024 pooled bottom-flux RMSE at T4, T8 and T16

temporal: R512 T8-T16 pooled bottom-flux RMSE and T4/T8/T16 descriptive order

adjudication.T16_TEMPORAL_PROGRESS_SPATIAL_GAP_NUMERI: Both temporal shifts progress and T16/T8 spatial gaps are equal within 1e-12.
adjudication.T16_TEMPORAL_PROGRESS_SPATIAL_GAP_REVERS: Both temporal shifts progress and T16 spatial gap is smaller than T8.
adjudication.T16_TEMPORAL_PROGRESS_SPATIAL_GAP_CONTIN: Both temporal shifts progress and T16 spatial gap is larger than T8.
adjudication.interpretation: Direction and continuous relative change are reported without introducing a post-selected stability threshold.

next_logic.if_spatial_gap_stable_or_reverses_and_te: A matched R2048 spatial extension at T16 may be prospectively considered.

next_logic.if_temporal_progress_fails: Diagnose Reference temporal/nonlinear behavior before any spatial or LARE extension.
